title: Bill Moore's spy training and Soviet postcard relays

tellings.quote: They had him like, you know, passing mail through and doing, you know, stuff with Soviet spies.

plain: In the early 1980s, a UFO researcher named Bill Moore was taken in by government handlers who trained him in spycraft and had him passing mail along and doing things involving Soviet spies. That is how a guest named Greg Bishop tells it to Michels, repeating what Moore told him. If true, it would mean intelligence officials were using a UFO researcher as their own operative.
